title: Beat visualizer synced by tempo (Canvas)
description: A music visualizer that hits exactly on the beat of a known-tempo bed: rings (a core that swells on each kick, mirrored radial bars, ripples per beat, a bar-progress arc), bars (a mirrored equaliser whose low, middle and top bands follow kick, backbeat and off-beats) or orbit (a square that snaps a quarter turn per beat, dots thrown out by each kick, a beat-of-bar marker). Kicker, title, credit and a beat counter enter on the first beats. It is synced by bpm and offset, not by analysing audio: pair it with an audio recipe at the same bpm.

title.description: Show, mix, channel or track name exactly as approved

credit.description: Line under the title: artist, host or schedule (empty for none)

kicker.description: Small tracked label above the title (empty for none)

bpm.description: Tempo; must equal the music's tempo (audio.pulse 90-128, audio.lofi-beat 60-100)

beats_per_bar.description: Beats per bar; beat 1 is the accented downbeat

offset.description: Seconds at which the first downbeat lands (0 for audio.pulse and audio.lofi-beat started at frame 0)

palette.description: Ground, ink (title), accent (downbeats, core, kicker) and second hue (gradient partner)

intensity.description: How hard each hit moves the shapes

offbeat.description: Flick on the off-beat eighths (hats) in the top band

loop.description: Copy leaves during the last bar so a whole number of bars loops

grain.description: Film grain amount (also prevents gradient banding)

notes: Needs `pip install playwright` and `playwright install chromium-headless-shell`.

Synced by tempo, not by audio analysis: beat k lands at offset + k*60/bpm s. audio.pulse places its kick at exactly k*60/bpm from 0 s, so lock the same bpm in both recipes and keep offset 0. Supplied music must match the tempo and start on a downbeat at the offset.
Hits are evaluated half a frame late so each one peaks on the frame nearest its beat (within 16.7 ms at 30 fps; exact when the beat is a whole number of frames, e.g. 120 bpm at 30 fps).
No full-frame strobing: one soft glow per kick; faster accents only move small elements.
